data_fields.name: ring_radius
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 (3 by 3 block around the edited cell)

data_fields.name: region_class_flags
data_fields.donor_constant: outside and hidden flags must match the seed

best_idea: Paint a zone from one seed by flood fill inside one connected region, taking that region's edge cell once and not crossing it; an edit that opens a wall next to a zone adds the wall ring to the zone.
decision_why: Use the connected-region paint with an edge fringe as an authoring tool that writes zone data; reject the runtime expansion on dig, which changes zone data during play and conflicts with zones as data.
acceptance: Zone-editor test (if built): a fill from a cell inside a room stops at the room's opening; the first cell past the opening is included once; a second fill from the same seed changes nothing.
